description: This file defines a custom exception class named DuplicateFinancialActivityAccountFoundException, which extends an application-specific base exception class. It is used to signal that a duplicate financial activity account mapping has been found, identified by a financial activity type.

classes.name: DuplicateFinancialActivityAccountFoundException
classes.description: Custom RuntimeException indicating a duplicate financial activity account mapping

methods.name: DuplicateFinancialActivityAccountFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code, a message including the financial activity type, and the type itself

methods.name: getErrorcode
methods.description: Static method returning the predefined error code string
